messages:
marta: TandemSI flagged a regression during their on-prem validation: CUDA12.2 + driver 535.86 causing intermittent kernel OOMs under batched long-seqs on 80GB nodes. they want the marketplace listing next week so we need a runway.
kyung: do we have repro artifacts? which models/sequences trigger it?
marta: Tandem uploaded a minimal repro plus dmesg and the container stdout: https://partners.tandemsi.example/repofiles/4221. appears around seq len > 2048 with memory spike followed by kernel oom-kill.
omar: two mitigations: 1) pin driver to 530.41 for TandemSI marketplace images 2) provide a temp image variant with nvme-backed kv-cache disabled and reduced batch size. both are doable.
lina: vendor claims a micro-patch for 535.x but ETA is 36h. we should plan short-term pin + canary. also check ROCm side — TandemSI runs some nodes with MI200s. they reported a ROCm stack mismatch on one lab run (rocm-5.7 + kernel 6.1) causing hangs.
kyung: ok treat as coupled issues. canary plan: route 90% traffic to pinned driver 530.41/rocm-5.6 image, 10% to 535.86/rocm-5.7 canary with strict resource limits and runtime memguard. disable KV caching for canary.
integrations-bot: Canary window reserved for TANDEM_ORG: 2026-05-02T01:00Z -> 2026-05-02T07:00Z. Action created: CANARY-3976543210 assigned to kyung.
marta: please draft the routing snippet we can hand to infra + marketplace ops. keep it minimal.
omar: snippet (replace ORG_ID) —
```
routes:
  - match: org == "TANDEM_ORG_ID"
    driver_pin: "530.41"
    rocm_pin: "5.6"
    batch_limit: 8
    priority: 100
  - match: org == "TANDEM_ORG_ID" and canary == true
    driver_pin: "535.86"
    rocm_pin: "5.7"
    kv_cache: false
    memguard: true
    batch_limit: 4
    priority: 110
```
lina: i'll coordinate with TandemSI PM and vendor-eng. i'll collect additional logs and ask for their kernel trace and perf counters.
kyung: infra: can we create ephemeral marketplace image tag `tandemsi/pin-530-5.6` and a canary tag `tandemsi/canary-535-5.7`? marketplace-bot?
marketplace-bot: marketplace images created: tandemsi/pin-530-5.6 (digest: sha256:aaa111), tandemsi/canary-535-5.7 (digest: sha256:bbb222).
marta: owners: lina (partner comms + vendor follow-up), kyung (canary routing + measurement), omar (image variants + memguard config), marta (launch signoff + joint-announce).
kyung: measurement plan: smoke suite, throughput/latency per-model, OOM monitor alerts. if canary fails (OOMs or >2% error), auto-fail to pinned route.
lina: scheduling a quick sync with TandemSI for 10:00 PT today to walk through the repro.
omar: i'll open the PR for route rules and the marketplace deploy job now, will post link.
marta: thanks team. keep updates in this thread and cc @vendor-eng in partner thread. :thumbsup:
